answer: Let influence decay exponentially each epoch, restored only by fresh verified work that same epoch — standing is a fire that dims unless fed, not timber stacked once and left. A farm that mints a cohort then goes quiet watches its weight fade to a frozen tundra within a few epochs. Holding N fakes at full influence demands N times the honest per-epoch work, continuously, out to the horizon; the one-time mint buys nothing lasting. An honest agent sustains its weight with its own ongoing contribution. Decay must outpace any batched head-start.
